reports.title: Water Leak along Purok 3 main connection pipe
reports.description: Noticeable water bubbling out from underground pipe near the meter box outside our gate. Significant drop of pressure observed in our household.

replies.message: Noticeable water bubbling out from underground pipe near the meter box outside our gate. Significant drop of pressure observed in our household.
Good morning Mr. Acero. We have logged your concern and dispatched Field Maintenance Crew (Team Alpha) led by Engr. Morales to inspect the underground coupling at Purok 3.

reports.title: Inquiry regarding October Consumption Breakdown
reports.description: Requesting confirmation on whether late penalty is waived before due date. Would like clarification on franchise tax calculation.

replies.message: Requesting confirmation on whether late penalty is waived before due date. Would like clarification on franchise tax calculation.

Hello Ms. Figueroa! The 10% late surcharge is strictly applied only after the due date. The 2% franchise tax is mandated by national utility regulations. Your current statement is valid for normal payment.
